title: Arrival, Departure and Room Upgrade Charges by Hotel Rate Plan
content:
Arrival before the property's standard check-in time, departure after its standard checkout time and an upgrade of the room are each charged at the amount contracted for the plan booked in the Hotel Rate Plans range.

| Rate plan | Early arrival | Late departure | Late departure guaranteed | Room may be upgraded | Upgrade, per night |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 65.00 USD | 75.00 USD | no | no | 0.00 USD |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 60.00 USD | 70.00 USD | no | no | 0.00 USD |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 50.00 USD | 60.00 USD | no | yes | 95.00 USD |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 40.00 USD | 50.00 USD | no | yes | 85.00 USD |
| Member Flex Rate | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | yes | yes | 65.00 USD |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 40.00 USD | 50.00 USD | yes | yes | 125.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | yes | yes | 150.00 USD |

The first two money columns are the charge for arrival before the property's standard check-in time and for departure after its standard checkout time. The third records whether a late departure is guaranteed rather than offered subject to availability. The fifth column records whether the room may be upgraded after booking, and the sixth the charge per night for an accepted upgrade.

**Basis questions.** *Which plans guarantee a late departure?* The Member Flex Rate, the Suite Flexible Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate. *Which plans carry no upgrade amount at all?* The Non-Refundable Saver Rate and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate, neither of which may be upgraded; both accordingly read 0.00 USD. *Which upgrade is dearest?* That of the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, at 150.00 USD a night.
